description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements the LogNode interface to wrap Android's native Log utility. It allows log messages to be processed and optionally chained to other LogNodes, facilitating concurrent logging targets.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility to allow flexible logging and chaining with other LogNodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message using Android's Log.println method, optionally appending stack trace information if an exception is provided, and propagating the log to the next node in the chain.
